# explanation/rules/trace.html.md

<a id="rules-trace"></a>

# Trace rules

The principles of the trace model and the rules on the trace graph.

<a id="XD-RULE-0001"></a>

| Method Rule: **The concrete side holds the link** [XD-RULE-0001](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0001)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.1<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0004](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0004), [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| A trace link is stored on the more concrete artifact. In the V-model, links point from right to left and from concrete to abstract. Backlinks such as “refined by” or “verified by” are never written; they are only computed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

<a id="XD-RULE-0002"></a>

| Method Rule: **Link types are declared on the need type that owns them** [XD-RULE-0002](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0002)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.2<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030), [XD-ADR-0057](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0057)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0001](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0001), [XD-CHECK-0002](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0002)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Every link type is declared only on the need type that holds it, in the shared needs configuration. There is no global link table. A link written on the wrong side, a link to an unknown ID, and a link to a wrong target type are build errors.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

<a id="XD-RULE-0003"></a>

| Method Rule: **Peer interfaces live in systems engineering** [XD-RULE-0003](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0003)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.3<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030), [XD-ADR-0131](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0131), [XD-ADR-0134](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0134)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Interfaces between peer domains (for example EE and ME) are interface needs (`SYS-IF`) in the systems engineering repo. Both domains link to the interface; neither domain links to the other. Two exceptions: SW reads the board pin maps from the EE model and may link to `EE-PCBA` and `EE-PORT` needs, while EE never links to SW; and ME writes board geometry into EE’s KiCad project, but only inside a co-design change, without any trace link from ME to EE.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

<a id="XD-RULE-0004"></a>

| Method Rule: **Allocation is stored on the concrete side** [XD-RULE-0004](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0004)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.4<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0030](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0030), [XD-ADR-0092](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0092)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| When a logical element is allocated to a product element, the product element `realizes` the logical element. The same holds from functional to logical elements.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

<a id="XD-RULE-0005"></a>

| Method Rule: **Variants are expressed with configs and where** [XD-RULE-0005](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0005)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.5<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0092](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0092), [XD-ADR-0093](explanation/decisions/method.html.md#XD-ADR-0093)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Variants follow VAMOS through PLEML. The core is the functional and logical architecture; variants live in the 150 % product architecture. Design elements and test cases carry `configs`, requirements carry `where`, and test results carry `config`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

<a id="XD-RULE-0006"></a>

| Method Rule: **Generated needs follow the same rules** [XD-RULE-0006](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0006)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/>legacy_id: trace-model 1.6<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0017](explanation/decisions/documents.html.md#XD-ADR-0017), [XD-ADR-0023](explanation/decisions/traces.html.md#XD-ADR-0023), [XD-ADR-0100](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0100)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Needs generated from SysML, KiCad, FreeCAD, code and test results follow the same rules as authored needs. Their links come from the source files: SysML `satisfy` and `:>` across the repo boundary, CAD trace fields, Doxygen `\satisfies` and ZTEST `\verifies`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

<a id="XD-RULE-0007"></a>

| A link is suspect when its target changed after the link was last confirmed. Suspect links are reported in pull requests and block a baseline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

| Method Rule: **Domain models conform to the system model** [XD-RULE-0047](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0047)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0130](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0130), [XD-ADR-0132](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0132)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0033](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0033)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| A domain def (board, connector, cable, assembly, mechanical port) specializes the system def it realizes or the interface def it meets. Every port it inherits from a system def is redefined somewhere in the chain by a port whose def specializes the inherited port’s def; inside port defs the same holds for the signal ports. A port name inherited more than once is redefined by one port that redefines all of them. The trace link of a specialization comes from the pair of kinds (`realizes` to a `SYS-EL`, `conforms` to a `SYS-IF`); a pair without a link type is a finding.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

| Method Rule: **One KiCad project per board def** [XD-RULE-0049](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0049)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace, cad<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0128](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0128), [XD-ADR-0135](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0135)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0035](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0035), [XD-CHECK-0036](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0036)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| A KiCad project is the `.kicad_pro` in its own folder `pcba/<name>/` or `proto/<name>/`, named like the folder, with the root sheet `<name>.kicad_sch`; no KiCad project file lies outside these folders. Each board def of the EE model (a def that specializes `XdDomain::Pcba` directly; a board variant, which specializes its board def, is not a board def of its own) has exactly one `pcba/` project, in the folder named after the def (`JointController` → `joint-controller`), whose text variable `TraceID` is the def’s `EE-PCBA` ID; every `pcba/` project names exactly one board def. External parts have no project. Links of a board come from the model, not from project variables.                                                                                                                                                                      |

<a id="XD-RULE-0055"></a>

|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace, cad<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0128](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0128), [XD-ADR-0137](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0137)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0046](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0046)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Each assembly or sub-assembly def of the ME model (a def that specializes `XdDomain::Assembly` directly, with an `ME-ASM` short name) has exactly one FreeCAD document, named after the def (`CanaryAssembly` → `canary-assembly.FCStd`), with one object whose `TraceID` is the def’s ID; every such document names one def. A top-level assembly is the folder `assemblies/<name>/` with the top document `<name>.FCStd` and `<name>-skeleton.FCStd`; its own parts sit in the folder, shared parts in `parts/`. No document refers to a top document: parts and sub-assemblies refer only to the skeleton. Links of an assembly come from the model, not from document properties.                                                                                                                                                                                              |

<a id="XD-RULE-0056"></a>

| Method Rule: **FreeCAD links follow the usages** [XD-RULE-0056](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0056)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace, cad<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0138](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0138)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0047](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0047)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| In the document of an assembly def, the number of FreeCAD links to a part or sub-assembly (named by the `TraceID` of the link target) equals its usages: the usages the ME model owns (internal parts and sub-assemblies, with multiplicity) plus the usages of the system model inside the system blocks the assembly realizes, counted for the ME def that realizes each used block. A link with `Configs` counts only for those configurations. Every other link target has a `TraceID`; the link to the skeleton is not counted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

<a id="XD-RULE-0057"></a>

| Method Rule: **The ME model drives the FreeCAD parameters** [XD-RULE-0057](explanation/rules/trace.html.md#XD-RULE-0057)  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-down-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="8 12 12 16 16 12"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16"></line></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="feather feather-arrow-right-circle"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><polyline points="12 16 16 12 12 8"></polyline><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12"></line></svg> <br/><br/>                                |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: trace, cad<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0137](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0137), [XD-ADR-0146](explanation/decisions/domains.html.md#XD-ADR-0146)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0048](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0048)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Every attribute with a value of a part or port usage of a top-level assembly def, or of the usage’s def, is a parameter with the alias `<usage>_<attribute>` in the spreadsheet `Params` of the assembly’s `<name>-skeleton.FCStd`; at most ten per assembly. `curatrix gen freecad-params` writes the values; the master sketch and the parts take their dimensions from `Params`. Each port with a placement (`x`, `y`, `z`, `yaw`, `pitch`, `roll` of `XdDomain::MechanicalPort`) has one LCS with the property `Port` = its `ME-PORT`, at that placement in the assembly. Values agree within the default tolerance of their kind (lengths 0.001 mm, angles 0.001 deg) or the one of `@XdDomain::ModelMatchTolerance` on the attribute, in the attribute’s own unit: the agreement of the number in the CAD file with the model, not a manufacturing tolerance. `Params` holds no alias the model does not know. |

| The direct children of an assembly (the links in the group of the object with the `ME-ASM` `TraceID`) do not overlap, per variant (a link with its own `Configs` is there only in the configurations it names): a common volume above 0.001 mm³ is an error, above 0.1 mm³ for parts joined by an assembly joint, which may touch. Other overlaps pass only when accepted in `assemblies/<name>/accepted.yaml` (rule `overlap`, items the two link names). Each board model in an assembly stays inside its `SYS-IF` space budget, in the form the co-design task gives it; until then this part is not checked.                                                                                                                                                             |

The connector tables are committed as `generated/<project>.connectors.json`, extracted in plain Python and equal to KiCad’s XML netlist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status: valid<br/><br/><br/>tags: checks, cad<br/><br/><br/><br/><br/>decided by: [XD-ADR-0126](explanation/decisions/checks.html.md#XD-ADR-0126), [XD-ADR-0144](explanation/decisions/scope.html.md#XD-ADR-0144)<br/><br/><br/>enforced by: [XD-CHECK-0040](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0040), [XD-CHECK-0041](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0041), [XD-CHECK-0043](reference/checks.html.md#XD-CHECK-0043)<br/><br/><br/><br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Every KiCad project passes ERC, and every board passes DRC (with the schematic parity test), apart from errors that are accepted: an entry of the project’s `accepted.yaml` (check, KiCad rule, designators or `all`, reason) or a KiCad exclusion, each counted only when the newest commit that wrote it carries an `Accepted-by:` trailer, has one parent and no agent mark, changes nothing but acceptance entries or exclusions, and every earlier commit of the entry is its ancestor. Anything else is a proposal. This relies on rebase merges, which keep the owner’s commit and its trailer; a squash merge turns every acceptance into a proposal, a merge commit never accepts. The unrouted nets of a board are accepted in one entry (`unconnected_items`, `all`). Warnings are listed, never fail. A KiCad exclusion is lost when its items move; a stale ERC exclusion of a rule that is off is a finding. |

| Every file of the board library is the FreeCAD model of a board version that the owner tagged (`<board>/vX.Y.Z` in the EE repo), written by `curatrix cam <ee repo> <board> --library`: its name gives board, version and variant, its `Board` object carries the board’s `EE-PCBA` ID, the version, the variant and the tag’s commit, and it is at most 5 MB. The tag must be on main of the EE repo and pushed (an agent never makes or pushes one).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
